== Description ==

[[Mike Turner]] (left, tan cap) and [[Jacy Smith]] (right) in a game, with [[Joe Phillips]] and [[Jonny Chu]] at the next table, at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025. Remaining background faces unlabeled.
